chroma_key.selection_reason: the base reference yielded no subject pixels once its background was excluded

play.action: four-frame one-shot scatter, designed for immediate readability over a #10131c game screen: frame 1 is a connected 36-pixel-thick opaque white-gold ring about 360 pixels across; frames 2 and 3 expand it to about 600 and 900 pixels; frame 4 holds a 1050-pixel ring with fewer attached embers. Every ring has a fully opaque bright core at least 32 pixels thick and attached hard-edged sparks 18-40 pixels wide. No faint dotted-only ring, tiny isolated specks, hairlines, or translucent-only particles. Keep the inside of the ring clear.

style: bold high-contrast expanding burst matching the accepted base image; thick fully opaque white-gold ring cores and attached hard-edged sparks with crisp clean edges, no pixel art, no dark outline, no palette reduction
